summary.en: Kogoro’s lecture was postponed as a result. Takagi reveals the evidence that proves Reizei’s testimony is correct. Conan and Haibara have to investigate the first murder again. They begin to discover something from the newspaper left from the scene, until Tsukaba disrupts the two and suggests them to tell their discover to Kogoro. The footage from the security camera at 2:55 p.m is the evidence that proves Mokichi Reizei is not the culprit of the murder of Inokoshi, meaning that he is indeed the one behind Junko's death. Reizei figured out his effort to make Junko understand the intention of respecting the former boss of the company is worthless, so he killed her in the process. The culprit for the first murder is Hideki Tsukinogi. Tsukinogi admits that he was the bodyguard for Inokoshi 1 year ago when the two encountered a strange woman, the woman was discovered to be Inokoshi's ex-lover who also got abused by him. However, after Tsukinogi explained everything and brought her to the police, Inokoshi fired him and spread rumours that drove Tsukinogi's company to bankruptcy. Conan is bothered with how Tsukuba was able to solve the case as well. Kogoro’s lecture begins with the intended schedule with the attendance of the surprising guest that was thought to never be in the first act of the lecture, Eri Kisaki.
